title: Cartwise Rewards Points Ledger Settings — Expiry Period and Refund Reversal Terms
content:
A Cartwise Rewards balance loses points in two ways besides redemption: unredeemed points expire after a period without activity, and points earned on an order are taken back when an item on it is refunded. The ledger settings for both are below.

## Expiry period by tier

| Tier | Calendar months after the last activity at which unredeemed points expire |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 12 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 12 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 18 |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 18 |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 24 |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 24 |

## Settings the same at every tier

| Setting | At every tier |
|---|---|
| Any earning or redemption resets the expiry clock of all points | Yes |
| How points are taken back when an order is refunded | In proportion to the amount refunded |
| A reversal may take the balance below zero | No |

## Reading the settings

- The expiry period is a count of calendar months, not of 30-day blocks: 12 months at Member and Bronze, 18 months at Silver and Gold, 24 months at Platinum and Diamond.
- Because any earning or redemption resets the clock for the whole balance, a Cartwise Rewards balance does not expire in slices by the date each point was posted; one earning or one redemption moves the clock for every point held.
- A points balance never goes below zero through a refund reversal at any tier.

## Hypothetical comparison

For a hypothetical balance whose last earning or redemption was posted on 10 April of a given year, the expiry period that applies is 12 calendar months at Cartwise Rewards Bronze, 18 at Cartwise Rewards Gold and 24 at Cartwise Rewards Diamond, so the same history reaches its expiry date on 10 April of the next year at Bronze, on 10 October of the next year at Gold, and on 10 April two years on at Diamond.
